SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rent_per_month AS double))) AS avg_rent FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE program_label = 'Public Housing' AND try_cast(rent_per_month AS double) > 0
Which counties grew fastest in population from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT geoname, round(100.0 * (try_cast(_2024 AS double) / try_cast(_2010 AS double) - 1), 1) AS growth_percent FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '2' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' AND try_cast(_2010 AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecular conformations does ANI-1x hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.ani1x_conformers
Which states' power plants emitted the most nitrogen oxides in 2022?
SELECT state, sum(nox_mass_lbs) AS nox_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) = 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the consumer price index for all items change from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUUR0000SA0' AND period = 'M13' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') ORDER BY year
Which parts of the Energy Department funded the most patented inventions?

SELECT coalesce(level_two, fedagency_name) AS office, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Energy' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark applications were filed in each of the last ten years?
SELECT substr(cast(filing_dt AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE filing_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
In which years did the most new generators come online?
SELECT operating_year, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the earliest patent in the library with "airplane" in its title?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, patent_date FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE lower(patent_title) LIKE '%airplane%' ORDER BY patent_date LIMIT 5
Which grid operators had the highest peak demand in July 2023?

SELECT replace(split_part(series_id, '.', 2), '-ALL', '') AS balancing_authority, max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'EBA.%-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '202307%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which counties are split among the most ZIP code areas?
SELECT namelsad_county_20, geoid_county_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the blood–brain barrier set are known to cross into the brain?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bbbp WHERE p_np = 1
In which states were home loans largest on average in 2023?

SELECT state_code, round(avg(try_cast(loan_amount AS double))) AS avg_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Medicare pay for longer office visits (code 99214) in New York in 2019?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Geography And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc = 'New York' AND hcpcs_cd = '99214' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%'
Which states send in the most vehicle safety complaints?
SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How large was New York State's labour force in 2024?
SELECT value AS labor_force FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000006' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M13'
Which kinds of federal lawsuits appear most often in the docket archive?
SELECT nature_of_suit, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE nature_of_suit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average weekly wage for private-sector workers in Brooklyn in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36047' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1'
Which materials have the highest computed refractive index?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(n AS double) AS refractive_index FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many clinical trial sites are recruiting patients now?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_locations WHERE status = 'RECRUITING'
On which days did WTI crude reach its highest spot prices?
SELECT period AS day, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many private foundations are registered with the IRS?
SELECT count(*) AS private_foundations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf WHERE cast(foundation AS varchar) IN ('2', '3', '4')
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many job openings were there in the U.S. at the end of 2024?
SELECT value AS openings_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000JOL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which metro areas have the largest share of residents aged 65 and over?

SELECT name, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) >= 14 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END) / sum(CASE WHEN try_cast(agegrp AS integer) = 0 THEN try_cast(tot_pop AS double) END), 1) AS pct_65_plus FROM govblock_census.popest_cbsa_est_alldata_char WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of hazardous waste enforcement actions does EPA take, rather than the states?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN trim(enforcement_agency) = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which facilities injected the most toxic chemicals underground in 2022?

SELECT _4_facility_name AS facility, _8_st AS state, round(sum(try_cast(_54_54_underground AS double))) AS pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark registrations were cancelled during 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(reg_cancel_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
